CustomField.formula: IF( EstimatedBirthdate__c >= TODAY(), 0, IF( MONTH(TODAY()) > MONTH(EstimatedBirthdate__c), YEAR(TODAY()) - YEAR(EstimatedBirthdate__c), IF( AND( MONTH(TODAY()) = MONTH(EstimatedBirthdate__c), DAY(TODAY()) >= DAY(EstimatedBirthdate__c) ), YEAR(TODAY()) - YEAR(EstimatedBirthdate__c), YEAR(TODAY()) - YEAR(EstimatedBirthdate__c) - 1 ) ) )
CustomField.label: Estimated Age
